metadata.description: Adversarial code review for Claude Code

plugins.name: code-gauntlet
plugins.description: Adversarial code review for Claude Code: each GitHub PR or GitLab MR runs a gauntlet of seven specialist reviewers for bugs, security, tests and cross-file impact plus a budgeted gap hunter for uncited regions, and every finding must survive verification, a skeptical validator, and a blind challenge before it is posted.
